content: Dispose of this product properly when it has expired or is no longer needed. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024. Important Usage Information: This document provides a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific situation. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your individual health needs. Precautions: Before using miconazole buccal tablets, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to miconazole or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients, such as milk protein concentrate, which could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly needed. It is not known whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Additional Notes: This medication has been prescribed for your current condition only.
